                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fix a solid shape by repairing its shells and faces.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Returns a new fixed solid, or nil on error.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          (fix-solid (make-box 10 20 30))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          See also: fix-shape, fix-face, fix-wire

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          FIX-WIRE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • WIRE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • FACE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • &KEY
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • TOLERANCE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Fix a wire, optionally projecting it onto a face.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            wire -- a wire shape to fix face -- a face shape to project onto (or nil) tolerance -- merging tolerance (default 0.1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Returns a new fixed wire, or nil on error.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            (fix-wire some-wire nil :tolerance 0.01)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See also: fix-shape, fix-edge, fix-face

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            FONT-INFO

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Query information about a font by name.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Returns a plist with :name and :key for the font, or nil if the font is not found in the system database.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (font-info "Arial")

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              See also: list-available-fonts, make-brep-font-from-name

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              FREE-ASPECT-FILL-AREA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Explicitly free an aspect-fill-area's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                FREE-ASPECT-LINE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Explicitly free an aspect-line's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  FREE-ASPECT-MARKER

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Explicitly free an aspect-marker's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    FREE-ASPECT-TEXT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Explicitly free an aspect-text's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      FREE-CLIP-PLANE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • CP
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Explicitly free a clip-plane's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        FREE-FILTER

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • FILTER
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Explicitly free a graphic-group's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            FREE-GRAPHIC-STRUCTURE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • GS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Explicitly free a graphic-structure's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              FREE-LIGHT

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • LIGHT
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Frees the C resource backing light.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Normally not needed — lights are garbage-collected automatically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  (let ((l (make-light :ambient)))
    (free-light l))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                FREE-OWNER

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Explicitly free an entity owner's C handle. Safe to call on nil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      FREE-SHADER-PROGRAM
